messages:
alex: Heads-up — onboarding a new external model (weights + tokenizer) for the search reranker experiment. Need quick sync on licensing + serving config.
maria: pinging the group. where are the weights and model card? can we verify license quickly?
alex: weights: s3://redwood-models/external/velvet-3b/v1/weights.tar.gz
alex: model card: https://internal.redwood/models/velvet-3b/v1/model_card.md
jin: I ran a lightweight tokenization pass — tokenizer uses an unusual BOS token id (not 0) and missing explicit <pad>. might need a small adapter in our loader.
olivia: @jin can you paste the tokenizer config or a sample tokenization edge case? I can add a fallback in the loader.
jin: snippet:
```
{"bos_token": "<s>", "bos_token_id": 1, "pad_token": null, "vocab_size": 50257}
```
jin: the missing pad token means our batching layer may hit shape issues unless we set pad_token_id to 0 and add a pad token to vocab.
license-bot: Automated license check: detected license file LICENSE.txt -> CC-BY-NC-4.0. Attribution required; commercial use restricted. (confidence: high)
alex: NC is a blocker for enterprise customers. we need legal to confirm whether we can serve behind paid SLA or if we need an exception.
samir: tagging legal-sig offline. @maria please add the model to the legal intake sheet with the ticket id.
maria: done — intake #ML-1129 added, linked model_card and weights path.
olivia: infra note: weights are in the S3 path with encryption SSE-KMS, but the inference pool config needs `kv_cache=true` and `max_seq_len=4096` in model.yaml. currently model.yaml has `max_seq_len: 2048` which will truncate some internal eval prompts.
alex: thanks — @olivia can you propose the minimal model.yaml diff so ops can validate? also add a metadata field for attribution string we can surface in docs.
olivia: proposed diff:
```
max_seq_len: 4096
kv_cache: true
pad_token_id: 0  # injected by loader fallback
attribution: "Velvet-3B (community release) — CC-BY-NC-4.0 — model distributed by VelvetAI"
```
maria: legal-sig response (from D. Porter): CC-BY-NC-4.0 prohibits "commercial" use; hosting behind a paid API is considered commercial. we can either
1) get an explicit license exception from the upstream (preferred), or
2) host for free under a research-only tier (but cannot expose to paying customers), or
3) vendor a different model with compatible license.
alex: ok — parallel action: jin + olivia do the tokenizer + config fixes and add tests; I'll try outreach to upstream for an exception. if we get exception, ops should be able to enable Dedicated serving.
jin: opened PR with tokenizer adapter + unit tests: https://git.internal/redwood/rlm/merge_requests/3245 — sets pad_token and remaps bos_id->0-safe path when needed.
olivia: created model.yaml change in infra repo MR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/1120 — includes attribution metadata and seq_len bump. added smoke test job `velvet-smoke`.
infra-bot: Deploy checklist reminder: ensure legal sign-off before enabling public or paid routes. Canary only in dev-vpc allowed without license exception.
samir: can we do a dev-vpc canary to exercise latency and cache behavior while legal handles license? ops needs the final model artifact sha.
olivia: artifact sha: sha256:4f8b2c9d... (uploaded). I'll coordinate canary; won't expose to production traffic until clearance.
maria: legal asked for a copy of the model card and the exact attribution string we plan to show — added to the intake. also requested contact info for upstream.
alex: action items summary:
- alex: outreach to VelvetAI for license exception (ETA 48h)
- jin: follow up on MR tests + address any review comments
- olivia: coordinate dev-vpc canary, finalize model.yaml, upload final artifact sha
- maria: track legal intake and update ticket ML-1129
- samir: prep ops runbook for canary rollback

alex: if upstream denies exception, we close this onboarding for paid hosts and consider a research-only experiment or a replacement model. :thinking_face:
maria: noted. will keep everyone updated in ML-1129. :thumbsup:
